title: Mixed Event — Run! Sports Festival! Committee Rush — Episode7 Many Congratulations

meta.Event Outline: Saki invites Haruka to join the Sports Festival Planning Committee. Together with fellow committee member Emu, they strive to make the Sports Festival a fun and joyful event, but how will it turn out?

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: The first years win...!

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: Emu Otori from 1-B beats the second-year team by a hair!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Woohoo! That was amazing!
You did amazing, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...!!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Looks like you won.
You were pretty fast, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(That was amazing.
She was shining just like...)

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Haruka!!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Haruka, we did it!
We won first place!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We sure did! Thanks to you too!
You did great back there...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! I couldn't have finished first without help from you and the others though♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haruka, you were amazing!
I couldn't believe what just happened!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You looked incredible out there!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma, Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Kiritani!
Thank you for taking my place!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, how's your leg?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
I sprained it after all, but no worries!
You helped us win the race so...!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And that's on top of working so hard for the planning committee. You've done a lot for us, and thanks to you, this Sports Festival turned out to be really fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka... Are those tears in you eyes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just really glad I came back to school...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I never had time for things like this when I was working.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm happy for you, but stop it or you're going to make me cry too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't expect you to turn around and run off like that right after finishing.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hahaha. Sorry...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just really wanted to go celebrate with Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds just like you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I want to celebrate with you too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Congratulations on winning, Emu!
You did wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. Thanks, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Good job out there, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Miku! You were cheering me on during the relay, weren't you?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I sure was! Could you hear me?!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! People always tell me I have really good ears♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Your cheers helped me have a lot of fun today! Thanks a bunch!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<I had a lot of fun too!
I'd never been to a Sports Festival before.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You did so well in so many different events that you were like a real-life superstar☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You think so? Thanks♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But everyone was a superstar today!
Did you see how big their smiles were?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Miku! Wanna come back and visit me at school some time?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Really? Can I?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Sure! I've been so busy today that we didn't really get a chance to talk.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I thought we could go on a little adventure together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow! That sounds super fun!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay, I can't wait to see what the rest of your school looks like♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, can I bring KAITO along?>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hurray! I'm sure he'll be excited too☆>

rows.Speaker: Committee Member's Voice
rows.Line: Otori!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uh oh...! I forgot we still have to clean everything up!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Okay, I'll head back too then!
Thanks for inviting me today♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <See you later, Emu!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay! See you!
